name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 4 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2025-12-01, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.02 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
